findings.title: AGENTS.md claims a figures.py CI check that no workflow runs
findings.reason: AGENTS.md states 'figures.py --check in CI' (line 67), but grepping all four GitHub workflow files (pr.yml, pr-web.yml, deploy-web.yml, release-app.yml) returns zero matches for 'figures'. An agent following the instructions will believe figure integrity is mechanically verified and may skip manual figure validation, allowing figure drift or regeneration failures to reach production undetected. The command 'python3 questions/generator/figures.py --check' is documented in AGENTS.md and exists in figures.py, so the repair is either adding the step to CI or removing the claim.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Resolve the mismatch between AGENTS.md's claim that 'figures.py --check in CI' runs and the absence of that step from all GitHub workflow files. Either add a 'python3 questions/generator/figures.py --check' step to the appropriate CI workflow (pr.yml for questions/** changes) or update AGENTS.md to remove the 'in CI' claim if the check is intended to be run manually only.

Limit the change to AGENTS.md and/or the relevant .github/workflows/*.yml file.

## Validation

- Grep for 'figures' across .github/workflows/ to confirm the step exists or the claim is removed
- Run 'python3 questions/generator/figures.py --check' to confirm the command works
- Confirm AGENTS.md no longer makes a claim that contradicts the CI configuration

findings.title: PR CI runs typecheck but not the full Vite build
findings.reason: The PR workflow (pr.yml) runs 'npm run typecheck' (tsc --noEmit only) for web/** changes, but does not run 'npm run build' (tsc --noEmit && vite build). The full build runs only in deploy-web.yml at deploy time. Vite build failures — import resolution, asset processing, plugin errors, or dead-code-elimination issues related to C-29/C-31 — are therefore caught at deploy time rather than on the PR, delaying feedback. The command 'npm run build' exists in web/package.json and deploy-web.yml already runs it, so the repair is adding the same step to the PR workflow.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add 'npm run build' (or at minimum 'vite build') to the web CI job in .github/workflows/pr.yml so that PRs catch Vite build failures before deploy. The command already exists in web/package.json and is already used in deploy-web.yml.

Limit the change to .github/workflows/pr.yml.

## Validation

- Confirm pr.yml runs 'npm run build' for web/** changes
- Run 'npm run build' locally to verify it passes
- Confirm the PR workflow still uses path filtering correctly
